expectation: Membrane/surface stain on antigen-presenting cells (macrophages, DCs, B cells) and some activated T or tumour cells. It should light a distinct subset, clustered in stroma or immune aggregates, with the rest of the tissue dim.
observed: A: yellow is strong in some cores, in patches and stromal bands, and near-absent in others, tracking tissue regions. B/C: sparse single elongated cells on dark background. D: discrete bright cells with defined edges. E: HLADR outlines cell membranes and overlaps CD14 partly, with HLADR-only cells too.
why: HLADR marks a distinct, regionally clustered subset of membrane-stained cells that partly overlap CD14, with clean negative background.
